name: afterglow-tv
description: Afterglow TV turns your Plex libraries into deterministic linear television channels, with a full guide, live tuning, catch-up, favorites and broadcast presentation. Plex provides the media; Afterglow maintains its own local inventory and schedules. Browser Origin defaults to auto for LAN setup. The optional Android TV APK is standalone and does not require this container. Beta: hardware and network compatibility varies.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, encrypted credentials, encryption material, uploads and cache. Back up this entire directory together.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Browser port. Match this port in Browser Origin.

variables.name: Browser Origin
variables.description: auto accepts same-origin browser requests using the actual host and port. For HTTPS reverse proxies, optionally set the exact public HTTPS origin.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Use true only with an HTTPS Browser Origin.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR. Do not share unredacted diagnostics.

variables.name: Upload Limit MB
variables.description: Maximum size of each compatible presentation video upload.
